$description: Light theme semantic layer. Traces to D-006 (color roles), D-008 (no decorative shadow, hairline instead, shadow reserved for floating layers), braun-flat.md (surface ladder, overlay hover/pressed). Elevation rule: surfaces get BRIGHTER as they float higher (canvas -> raised -> overlay), and DARKER when recessed (inset) — same physical logic reused symmetrically in dark.json.

surface.$description: Elevation ladder (braun-flat.md) using only warm-neutral steps, brightness = elevation. No decorative shadow is used to communicate elevation (D-008) — lightness step does that job instead.

bg.$description: D-006 exact mapping: bg.canvas = neutral.50, bg.surface = neutral.0/25 — expressed here as aliases into the surface.* ladder so there is one source of truth for the ramp step.

border.$description: D-008 rule 1: border.hairline replaces decorative shadow as the sole definition/edge cue for card/button/input in normal flow. hairlineStrong is +2 ramp stops darker, used by @media (prefers-contrast: more) per braun-flat.md rule 5, and by contrast-more.json. interactive (D-014, QA W2 Wave 2 finding #2) is a separate, darker step reserved for borders that ARE the visible boundary of a focusable/interactive control (e.g. Button outline) — hairline (neutral.200, ~1.3:1 on canvas) was designed for quiet layout dividers, not for a 3:1 WCAG non-text/UI-component boundary; neutral.500 measures 3.72:1 on canvas / 3.96:1 on raised, passing.

action.$description: D-006 action.primary = brand.700 (supersedes brand.600 — see D-014, QA W2 Wave 2 findings #3/#4: brand.600 measured 4.02:1 as TEXT/border on bg.canvas, below the 4.5:1 AA text minimum; brand.700 measures 6.38:1) · D-001/braun-flat accent-scarcity rule: use action.primary only on the single most important interactive element per view. States use fill/border shifts, never shadow (braun-flat rule 4). action.danger.default likewise moved 600->700 (D-014) for the same reason (danger.600 was 4.46:1 on canvas, just under AA).

role.$description: Wave 2 (D-013) addition — non-interactive role-tinted surfaces for Badge (solid/subtle/outline x neutral/brand/success/warning/danger/info, D-006). 'brand' reuses the accent ramp but Badge is informational-only (not clickable), so this does NOT count against the D-001/braun-flat accent-scarcity rule the way an interactive action.primary element would — still used sparingly by convention. solid = high-contrast fill+white text (readable on its own); subtle = light tint bg + darker-step text (readable on canvas, no separate border needed); subtleText mirrors the solid hue at a darker step for AA contrast on the light tint.

overlay.$description: braun-flat.md — systematic hover/pressed cue via thin alpha over fill instead of shadow. Light theme uses black alpha (darkens on top of light fill); scrim is black in both themes.

shadow.$description: D-008 + braun-flat rule 2 — ONLY for modal/popover/toast/dropdown. Never for card/button/input/badge in normal flow.

focusRing.$description: a11y-critical, single spec per D-006/blueprint §4.8 — brand.600 validated at 4.02:1 non-text contrast against surface.canvas (passes WCAG 3:1 UI-boundary minimum).
